column3: Complete 774-line pinned body read; discovery focused on live selection, predicate composition, sorted membership/navigation and detached snapshots.
column4: Runtime Set/SortedSet/NavigableSet dispatch; persistent binary-carry conjunction trees; owner-backed selection iterators/spliterators; single-pass filtered/sorted reference snapshots; saturated size; stored representative mutation.
column5: Reusing these atoms in older wrappers requires separate callback-order/retry, comparator-domain, stored-identity, optional-mutation and spliterator-characteristic proof; source discovery alone does not admit substitution.

column3: Complete 315-line pinned body and original-to-f29 diff read; change scope selectedDistinct.
column4: The upstream delta removes the explicit identity row-ID array and calls M3IndexMaskCompactor.selectPositions; existing distinct-key/count snapshots, fail-fast revision and stable index merge remain.
column5: Selection states must stay aligned to distinct-key encounter order; selected counts and stored key references still populate an independent count store. New position-export fallback belongs to the compactor owner and requires independent runtime proof.

column3: Complete 349-line pinned body and original-to-f29 diff read; change scope additive selectPositions and native capability probe.
column4: Count-then-fill logical positions avoid an identity input lane; all-selected Java output generates positions directly; a lazy positions ABI probe selects the new native export or the original native selector with an identity array.
column5: Required-mask validation, ascending logical coordinates, detached output and explicit NATIVE_REQUIRED behavior remain the stated boundary. Fresh integration ABI review must include the added position exports; no automatic Java fallback or new substitution is admitted by this audit.

column3: Complete 215-line pinned body and original-to-f29 diff read; change scope filtered projection and its documented JNI boundary.
column4: The filter emits logical positions through selectPositions, remaps them in place through positions[from+ordinal], and defers the physical BitSet; the prior full physical-index window copy and eager membership construction leave this path.
column5: Preserve once-per-occurrence Java callback order, null/duplicate physical identity, slice offsets, detached indices, lazy membership and explicit native-required behavior. Reuse and measured allocation/throughput claims require separate contract and runtime evidence.

column3: Complete 423-line pinned body and original-to-f29 diff read; change scope IndexView.sortedByValue callback and publication checks.
column4: The stable slot-ID merge now checks the owning table revision immediately after each comparator callback and before publishing its descriptor; pair packing, recycled coordinate/slot lanes and index-window selection remain incumbent.
column5: Reentrant value/state/structural mutation must not publish a view over recycled slots; unchanged comparator failures still propagate before the epoch check. The owner is single-threaded. No concurrency guarantee or new mask-selection rewrite is admitted.

column3: Complete 377-line pinned body and original-to-f29 diff read; change scope retainByStateMask zero-mask branch.
column4: After the incumbent null/length/mask validation, requiredMask==0 now returns zero before scanning or writing the circular lane; nonzero compaction, power-of-two addressing and predicate-failure suffix preservation remain unchanged.
column5: Any reuse must preserve validation precedence, logical rather than physical state alignment, head/size and iterator epoch on a no-op. The distinct filterInPlace partial-commit callback contract must not be replaced by atomic removeIf behavior.

column3: Complete new 164-line pinned public owner read; discovery of long-row detached and resumable selection.
column4: Composes 32-bit state planes over checked physical offsets and a signed-stride logical path; detached selection counts then fills, while bounded windows preflight the inspected prefix and pack next ordinal plus written count.
column5: Rows may duplicate and remain in path order; logical ordinals are distinct from physical state positions. Preserve empty/alias/offset validation and MAX_WINDOW=4096. This owner declares Java-only long specialization and adds no JNI export; no native extension is admitted here.

column3: Complete new 402-line pinned public owner read; discovery of caller-owned evidence plans, pair workspaces and explicit certificates.
column4: Caches one row pair in primitive evaluated/sign/gap lanes; refines ordered or metric dimensions on demand; invokes a canonical verifier only when an explicit complete exact schema cannot certify order; snapshots clone evidence arrays.
column5: Source snapshot lifetime, declared exact ordinals, metric maximum-gap certificates and outward-rounded bounds remain caller/domain authorities. Rank signs do not imply object equality. Callback failure/commit timing and cache invalidation require their own proof before reuse; no sorter or JNI extension is admitted.

column3: Complete new 221-line pinned public owner read; discovery of masked lexicographic order and projection callback schedule.
column4: Applies the incumbent M3SignalOrder from least-significant dimension to most-significant dimension while composing primitive row permutations; project evaluates selected rows dimension-by-dimension. The file declares Synexia MatSignalDimensions PR11656 lineage (pointer only).
column5: Preserve source-row mask alignment, tuple tie stability, Double.compare sign/separation distinctions and explicit backend admission. valueAt is called once per selected row per dimension; caching it once per row would change callbacks. Donor body and new substitutions are not qualified here.

column3: Full 341-line f29 source body and original-to-f29 diff read serially; discovery focuses on added logical-position capability and existing primitive-region borrow structure.
column4: Adds positionsAbiNative returning 1 and selectPositionsNative; validates unsigned-byte masks, reuses bounded m3_count_window, allocates an exact NewIntArray, and emits offset+i directly from 256-element stack state/position buffers. The zero-mask path generates identity coordinates without state-region reads. Accepted/written guards and pending-exception checks protect count/fill operations. Existing row-selector/range/window exports are unchanged in the diff.
column5: The added position export receives no row array and therefore needs no GetIntArrayRegion for row IDs. Java owns old-library capability fallback. Fresh integration ABI baselines must include the two added exports. Source discovery does not establish JNI runtime behavior, allocation/performance gains, or drift-proof sufficiency; stable input-array assumptions and exact-count failure paths require receiving evidence. No critical pins, retained pointers, callbacks or object-valued JNI lanes were added.
